title: TransferV2Response
description: TST-030 (Task 10): the published response contract for POST /v2/transfers. Strictly additive over transfer-v1.schema.json (adds settledAt only; transferRef and status are unchanged). additionalProperties is false so the schema-drift defect's field rename (transferRef -> transfer_id, see TransferV2Controller) is caught as a missing required property, not silently tolerated as an extra one.

transferRef.description: UUID of the completed double-entry transfer (TransferService, TST-021).

settledAt.description: Timestamp the transfer settled, captured immediately after TransferService#transfer commits.
